product: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
tagline: Larger PDF uploads: You can now upload PDFs with up to 100 pages to Genie One and Genie Agents, increased from 20.
what_it_does: Larger PDF uploads: You can now upload PDFs with up to 100 pages to Genie One and Genie Agents, increased from 20. Summarize up to six months of activity: Authors can now summarize up to six months of Genie Agent activity from the Monitor tab. Agents use only attached sources: A Genie Agent now uses only the data assets explicitly attached as sources.
why_it_matters: Before sharing the agent with users, Databricks recommends adding example SQL queries, instructions, and knowledge store configurations to improve response accuracy.
